appearance_facts.fact: Title 'Additional Promotion Weeks: Ad Spend vs Sales' sits above the plot area.
Five blue circular scatter points are arranged in a clear upward diagonal from bottom-left to top-right.
The lowest point (Week 7) is near x=30, y=65; the highest point (Week 11) is near x=70, y=160.
Weeks 8, 9, and 10 form a steady rising line between Week 7 and Week 11 with no visible outliers or gaps.
Y-axis runs from 60 to 170 in increments of 10, labeled 'Sales ($ thousands)'.
X-axis runs from 25 to 75 in increments of 5, labeled 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)'.
